title: Mirabel and the Letters
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Oscar Almeida, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
